fields.name: errorCode
fields.about: 0 if the tag was created successfully; otherwise a non-zero error code (e.g., TAG_NAME_TOO_LONG, TAG_ALREADY_EXISTS, INVALID_TAG_NAME).

fields.name: errorMessage
fields.about: A human-readable error message if error_code is non-zero. Null or empty on success. Examples: 'tagName must not exceed 16 characters', 'Tag name already exists', 'tagName contains invalid characters; only alphanumeric, '_' and '-' allowed'.

fields.name: tagId
fields.about: The numeric identifier assigned to the newly created tag. Set to 0 (or -1 by server convention) when error_code is non-zero.
